# Reader access verification

All checks are Not run.

| Check | Evidence required | Authority |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Source parity | Re-read 005, 004, current main and Make snapshot | Read-only |
| Canonical containment | Resolve root, ancestors, symlinks and artefact links | Required before later writes |
| Identifier traceability | Verify every RA origin and 004 source-qualified reference | Documentation review |
| Decision consistency | Compare 005, 004 and Linear v1.13.0 | Documentation review |
| Protected delivery | Controlled direct chapter and public-bundle requests | Separate runtime authority |
| Code lifecycle | Single-use, expiry, resend, limited, invalid and concurrent redemption | Separate provider/test authority |
| Recovery | Same profile, new device, sign-out, revocation, storage clear and renewal | Separate runtime authority |
| Consent separation | Access never creates newsletter subscription; double opt-in/unsubscribe separate | Separate provider authority |
| Accessibility | Keyboard, focus, screen-reader, contrast and responsive review | Separate review authority |
| Deployment | Inspect main push trigger and deployed revision | Release authority |

No tests, commands, provider calls, form submissions or deployment checks were run for this package. WCAG 2.2 AAA remains a target, not a conformance claim.
